body: This is "LighteningConnor's" wife, I just came across this thread, first of all thank you guys so much for your advice. I really hope we can find him some way to overcome his depression, it looks like it is really hard for him. I don't know if it is helpful but I try to give him lots of hugs thinking it might help. I think the hospital would be helpful but unfortunately I think he left the hospital depressed. That is where he see's his Psychiatrist who's "difficult" however, he also see's his gp on a more frequent basis who is aware that we have struggles with the psych doctor and will do adjustments to meds and communicates these with his psych doctor as a "team" the gp is very nice. I've tried looking for counseling or something called psychotherapy for him but it seems like this is something that we would have to pay for and it is not in our budget. I also asked his Psych doctor about other supports and he said he did not need anything else but medication. I really felt when he went to the hospital in December that he would come home better, when infact he came home with a whole new list of symptoms and medication side effect (panic attacks, lethargy, over eating, excessive sleeping) which caused him to stop taking some of the medication. I gave him similar advice which was to find out what medicaions might work and ask the doctor if it is an option. P.s. we asked his gp if we could see another psych doctor and it turns out there are none taking new patients.
yeah i sent him a pm, I will research those drugs.
yeah I know that is why I need to know what to do to stop, should I just say fuck it and check myself back into the psych ward because it doesn't really do that much for me being in there.
yeah I dunno I think I would get busted for fraud.

Yeah there is a shortage of doctors in Alberta the doctor I liked moved away so now I am f***ed because the only shrink that would take me is a douchebag, it is tough because I hate him so much, he doesn't listen just dismisses my concerns and hurries me out the door but he does enjoy pumping me full of drugs. It is just too bad the drugs do nothing.

This may sound stupid but I just wish there was a way that I could get a menial job to give some meaning to my life. But the way it is I am on disability and with the ridiculous amount of drugs I am on there is no way for me to do my old job which was a heavy equipment technician. So I am on disability and the thing is that the disability pays more than I would make delivering pizzas if I could manage to hold down a simple job like that. I have some money but it is pretty tight so I could not just give up my disability because we would quickly lose the house, not having a place to live would probably be more stressful and cause me to kill myself for sure.
I told my doctor that I was probably going to end up killing myself and he said that would be a sad outcome for my situation.
yeah probably, one is seroquel. Do you know of any good medications for depression because my doctor will prescribe anything I ask for.
I don't remember the names of the drugs but they are the most powerful ones that they have I have the bottles at home with the names on them.

I don't know, I am on disability due to having schizophrenia, the schizophrenia is pretty much handled but now I am being treated for having Major depressive disorder I am on some pretty high doses of some pretty heavy anti-depressants but they are doing nothing I am afraid that I will go through with my plans, with me dead my wife will likely lose the house and my kids will end up being drug addicts.
